check: Complete ordering, payment and warehouse workflows on real phones, tablets and foldables using touch, rotation, split screen and posture changes.
Verify virtual keyboards, browser toolbars, safe areas and sticky controls never obscure focused fields, validation messages or checkout actions.
Verify forms and carts survive refresh, back navigation, session expiry, app switching and interrupted uploads without duplicate submissions or silent data loss.
Review realistic catalogs, long Polish product names, hundreds of order lines, empty states and bulk actions for usable navigation and clear outcomes.
Complete every role's critical workflow using only a keyboard, checking focus order, visible focus, dialogs, menus and focus restoration.
Test critical workflows with representative desktop and mobile screen readers, including table headers, field instructions, errors and dynamic status announcements.
why_forgotten: Semantic validity is mistaken for usability.

check: Verify errors do not rely on color, drag actions have alternatives, motion can be reduced and timeouts provide accessible warning and extension.
Measure route-level loading and interaction latency by device, connection and customer cohort using production telemetry with explicit budgets.
why_forgotten: Laboratory LCP and CLS look healthy.

check: Benchmark search, filtering, pagination, exports and dashboards against production-scale data while checking query counts, indexes, memory and response sizes.
Exercise hours-long admin and warehouse sessions for memory leaks, accumulated subscriptions, stale caches and progressively slower interactions.
Attempt cross-customer access to orders, prices, invoices, exports and attachments by changing identifiers through every API and download path.
Verify an explicit role-by-action-by-resource matrix for admin, accountant, warehouse, sales rep and customer across UI, API, bulk operations and exports.
why_forgotten: Only representative happy paths are tested.

check: Verify revoked roles, disabled users and changed customer assignments take effect in active sessions and that impersonation is restricted and audited.
Test invitations, account enumeration, password resets, MFA where required, session rotation, logout, recovery and session invalidation after credential changes.
Test injection, stored XSS, CSRF, SSRF and unsafe uploads across APIs, ERP fields, rich text, filenames and document previews.
Scan source, built assets, images and dependencies for exposed credentials, vulnerable packages and unapproved artifacts before deployment.
Verify production headers, TLS, CORS, storage permissions and debug endpoints, including source maps and signed-link expiration.
Map personal data through the app, ExampleERP, Tpay, email, analytics, logs, backups and AI services, documenting purpose, access and retention.
why_forgotten: Data spreads beyond the main database.

check: Rehearse access, correction, export, restriction and deletion requests across connected systems while preserving records subject to applicable retention obligations.
Verify telemetry, session replay, support tools, test environments and model prompts exclude or redact unnecessary personal and confidential commercial data.
Check which cookies and trackers require consent, verify applicable blocking and withdrawal behavior and ensure recorded choices match actual network activity.
why_forgotten: Banner appearance is tested instead of behavior.

check: Have the applicable B2B terms, privacy notices, accessibility obligations and checkout disclosures reviewed, and retain versioned acceptance evidence where needed.
why_forgotten: Legal text is treated as static content.

check: Confirm current KSeF applicability with accounting advisers and test required invoice submission, identifiers, statuses, corrections and supported outage procedures.
why_forgotten: Invoice generation is mistaken for compliance.

check: Round-trip Polish diacritics through forms, databases, search, ERP, email, XLSX, PDF and filenames without encoding corruption or normalization surprises.
Test decimal commas, grouped amounts, PLN display, VAT rates, discounts, unit precision and agreed rounding rules consistently across all systems.
why_forgotten: Formatting and accounting rules get conflated.

check: Verify Europe/Warsaw daylight-saving transitions, date-only fields, payment deadlines and export timestamps across browsers, servers and integrations.
Verify agreed Polish collation, case and diacritic matching, natural product-code sorting and preservation of leading zeros in business identifiers.
Render transactional emails in supported Outlook, Gmail and mobile clients with images blocked, dark mode, long content and a usable plain-text alternative.
Verify sender authentication, bounce handling, suppression, reply routing and recipient selection without leaking addresses or another customer's attachment.
why_forgotten: Provider acceptance is mistaken for delivery.

check: Open exports in supported Excel and LibreOffice versions, checking formulas, formula-injection defenses, types, diacritics, leading zeros and monetary precision.
why_forgotten: A valid ZIP file counts as success.

check: Verify exported rows, filters, totals and access scope against source records, including large files, attachment limits, retries and expiring download links.
Check A4 pagination, repeated table headers, totals, Polish fonts, barcodes, hidden controls and readable grayscale output for long orders and invoices.
Verify public-page metadata, canonical URLs, sitemaps and status codes while enforcing authentication for private data and using indexing directives appropriately.
why_forgotten: SEO is dismissed for B2B applications.

check: Verify documented events fire once with correct amounts, currencies and business identifiers across consent states, retries, redirects and client-side navigation.
why_forgotten: Dashboards can look plausible with bad data.

check: Trigger frontend, backend and worker failures to verify release attribution, readable stack traces, correlation IDs, privacy filtering and alert delivery.
why_forgotten: SDK installation is treated as completion.

check: Monitor stuck orders, payment mismatches, ERP synchronization lag, export failures and email backlogs with owners and actionable alert thresholds.
Trace an order across API, queue, Tpay, ExampleERP and email while recording attributable changes to permissions, prices, bank details and order state.
Restore databases, attachments, configuration and required keys into an isolated environment and verify business workflows against stated recovery objectives.
Rehearse recovery without duplicating payments, ERP documents or emails, reconciling restored local state against external systems.
why_forgotten: External side effects cannot be restored.

check: Rehearse schema changes and backfills on representative data volumes for lock duration, partial failure, restartability and old/new application compatibility.
Rehearse application rollback, feature disabling and recovery from incompatible data changes, including workers, caches and queued payloads.
why_forgotten: Redeploying an old image seems sufficient.

check: Verify per-user and per-tenant limits for login, search, checkout, exports and uploads with predictable errors and protection against expensive requests.
why_forgotten: Only obvious authentication endpoints are limited.

check: Inject ExampleERP, Tpay and email-provider timeouts, throttling and outages to verify bounded retries, backoff, queue limits and recoverable failure states.
Run critical workflows on agreed browser and OS versions, including iOS Safari, Android Chrome and Windows browsers with relevant download and popup behavior.
why_forgotten: A device matrix can use one engine.

check: Verify service-worker updates, cache invalidation, logout and account switching cannot expose another user's data or serve incompatible application versions.
why_forgotten: Offline checks focus on connectivity banners.

check: Verify supported offline actions show pending status and reconcile reconnects, conflicts and repeated submissions without silently overwriting server changes.
why_forgotten: Reconnect is assumed to mean success.

check: Verify correct recipients, deduplication, ordering, preferences, permission denial and authorized deep links across email, in-app and push channels.
why_forgotten: Sending one notification proves too little.

check: Assert valid order transitions and consistent totals, stock reservations, invoices and payment balances across all write paths and integration events.
Race stock reservations, discount usage, order edits and status changes from multiple roles and tabs to verify atomicity and explicit conflict handling.
Replay duplicate, delayed and out-of-order requests, callbacks and jobs to verify exactly one intended business effect and safe state transitions.
why_forgotten: Distributed delivery is modeled as reliable.

check: Verify existing orders preserve agreed product descriptions, prices, tax treatment and addresses when catalogs or customer records change.
why_forgotten: Live references are convenient during implementation.

check: Validate identifiers, units, VAT, warehouses, customer-specific pricing and document statuses against representative ExampleERP data with explicit ownership of each field.
why_forgotten: Technically valid mappings can be commercially wrong.

check: Detect missing, duplicated, rejected and manually changed ERP records and verify operators can reconcile or replay them without duplicate documents.
why_forgotten: Integration success is measured per request.

check: Verify callback authenticity, amount, currency and order binding, and ensure browser redirects alone cannot mark orders as paid.
Test abandoned, expired, delayed, duplicate and mismatched payments plus supported partial or full refunds and settlement reconciliation.
Load-test concurrent customer checkout, warehouse updates, admin reports and exports against latency, error-rate and resource budgets.
Run soak and burst tests to verify queue drainage, worker recovery, connection-pool limits and tenant fairness after downstream outages.
Test scheduled jobs across daylight-saving changes, overlapping runs, worker crashes and deployments, including lock expiry and missed-run recovery.
why_forgotten: Jobs execute outside interactive test flows.

check: Exercise database failover, cache loss, storage exhaustion, expired credentials and unavailable dependencies with observable degradation and documented recovery.
Rehearse an incident with named owners, customer communication, safe diagnostic access and procedures to recover stuck orders and integrations.
Run safe post-deploy checks for each critical role and integration while detecting configuration, feature-flag and environment differences from staging.
why_forgotten: A green build is treated as a release verdict.

check: Review critical workflows against approved business examples and accounting expectations using evidence independent of the implementation and its generated tests.
why_forgotten: Code and tests can share the same misconception.

check: Use targeted fault injection or mutation checks to confirm critical tests fail for incorrect permissions, totals, callback validation and duplicate processing.
why_forgotten: Passing tests do not prove useful assertions.

check: Regularly turn support tickets, abandoned workflows, production incidents and actual browser usage into prioritized regression cases and updated support assumptions.
why_forgotten: The harness evolves separately from real usage.

check: Assign owners and alerts for domains, certificates, payment and email accounts, ERP licenses, quotas and vendor credentials before they expire or exhaust.
why_forgotten: These failures live outside application code.
